headline: The sentence in your head when your toddler melts down in the store
body:
~~Everyone is watching me fail at this.~~
_Everyone in here has had a two-year-old, or been one._

~~I should be able to stop this.~~
_It isn't mine to stop. It's mine to stay for._

~~They think I've spoiled them.~~
_They don't know them. I do, and this isn't all of them._

~~We should just go home.~~
_We can. Or we can finish the list. Both count._
